# hpe_opsramp_integration_app (Resource)

Manages an OpsRamp SDK APP Integration (v3 API). Use this resource for integrations with category `SDK APP` (e.g. hpe-alletra-6000, snmp, kubernetes).




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application` (String) The application identifier (e.g. `hpe-alletra-6000`, `snmp`, `kubernetes`).
- `version` (String) The version of the app to install (e.g. `1.0.0`, `2.0.0`).

### Optional

- `bypass_resource_reconciliation` (Boolean) Whether to enable bypass resource reconciliation during discovery for this installation.
- `client` (String) The unique ID of the client (sub-tenant) where the app should be installed. If not provided, uses the provider tenant.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) The display name assigned by OpsRamp after installation.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the installed app (e.g. INTG-...).
- `state` (String) The state of the installed app (e.g. Installed).
- `status` (String) The current status of the installed app (e.g. Install Request Sent).
